notes.title: Cloud Gardens dev announces new game at PC Gaming Showcase!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everybody![/p][p][/p][p]Thomas. Just wanted to let you know that my next project, GARBAGE COUNTRY, has been officially announced to the world. Big thanks to the PC Gaming Showcase for having me. Check out the trailer here![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="d4S9pdUVML8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]As you can see it’s got a similar post-industrial aesthetic to [b]Cloud Gardens,[/b] but taken in a very different direction. This is an open world exploration game where you drive a truck across a trash-littered wasteland, upgrading your car to go further and defending yourself in tense tower-defense battles.[/p][p]
[/p][p]If that sounds like something you’d enjoy, please consider dropping me a wishlist! You can also follow me on socials for development updates :) [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much!
[/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Thomas

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0: Sandbox Camera Improvements
notes.content:
This update introduces two new features for controlling the camera in Sandbox mode:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/7525be410a1be679f9d06f292ca84a444cf3ff8e.gif[/img]
You can now select an object and press [F] to [b]focus the camera on that object[/b]. From then on, the camera will 'spin' around that object when building. This automatically turns off 'auto focus' for that level. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/7891a2ef273cce6138375ea017a929ea5239a88d.gif[/img]
You can save up to three [b]camera viewpoints[/b]. Sometimes you've found a good camera angle in Photo Mode, but then you want to resume building for a little bit, and return to exactly that angle. You can do this now as follows: 
[list]
[*]In Photo Mode, when you have moved the camera to your desired viewpoint, press [CTRL + 3], [CTRL + 4], or [CTRL + 5] to store that viewpoint under that number. 
[*]Later, press [3], [4], or [5] to restore the camera to that viewpoint.

[/list]


All hotkeys are available for rebinding in the Settings menu.

notes.title: Cloud Gardens review: zen gardening in the middle of the wasteland
notes.content:
The post-apocalypse is often accompanied by violence, grit and gore when it comes to video games. So many titles use the inevitable wasteland to emotionally torture their characters or as a playground to squash some monsters – or both. Cloud Gardens abandons all the blood and tears. Refreshingly, the game doesn’t rely on any drama or conflict. Instead, Cloud Gardens is solely focused on the idea of revitalisation and nature taking back spaces… after we’re gone.

Read more

notes.title: Cloud Gardens 1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Gardeners, 

The time has come, Cloud Gardens is leaving early access, and version 1.0 is available now! The launch version introduces a host of features, including new levels, items, a branching overworld map, improved creative mode tools, music, and so much more! 

Additionally the game is now available in 7 new languages and has full controller support. 

Now is the best time to purchase Cloud Gardens! After the window of our launch discount ends, we will be increasing the base price of the game to $17.99 USD, to reflect all of the new content we've added since first launching in Early Access. 

Over the past year and a half of development our game has grown in new and unexpected ways, so much so thanks to our amazing Early Access community. Without your constant support and feedback the game would not look the way it does today. 

Thank you to everyone who has played our game in early access and let us know what it meant to you. And welcome to everyone who is picking up Cloud Gardens for the first time at release, we hope you enjoy our digital plants as much as we do. 

Happy Gardening, 
The Cloud Gardens Team

notes.title: Pretty apocalypse puzzler Cloud Gardens is outgrowing early access
notes.content:
Urban decay and environment puzzler Cloud Gardens emerged in early access last September and has now announced that it's blooming into full release nearly a year to the day later. These little post-apocalyptic dioramas have levels with challenges for you to complete campaign style and a creative mode for sandbox building creations. After spending a year tweaking features, the developers have announced it will be leaving early access on September 1 with an update bringing 15 new levels, 120 new objects, and lot more.

Read more

notes.title: Cloud Gardens is leaving Early Access September 1st
notes.content:
Cloud Gardens is leaving early access on September 1st! We've been hard at work at a combination of new features, quality of life improvements, and language support, and we're thrilled to be releasing so soon. 

The full release features a Branching Overworld Map. It weaves together all of the existing levels and introduces more than 15 new levels. The Creative Mode is also getting updated, adding more than 120+ new items, the ability to create custom skyboxes, and dozens of smaller quality of life improvements. We've also added long requested Achievements! 

Here's a more detailed list of just some of the things we're launching with: 

[list]
[*] Language Support: Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, and Spanish
[*] A Branching Overworld Map
[*] 15+ New Levels
[*] 120+ New Items
[*] Freecam Mode
[*] Customizable Skyboxes
[*] Achievements
[*] Full Controller Support
[*] And More!
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who's been with us since the beginning, your support has meant so much! And welcome to all the new folks who discover our game at launch, we hope you enjoy these digital gardens. 

See you on September 1st!

notes.title: Update #4: Industrial Levels & Controller Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/a796cd10f56ae786c2e8020684965fad73c363f6.png[/img]

Hello Cloud Gardeners!

Spring is around the corner and with it comes a new Cloud Gardens update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/b77e8e85e8189e714df306afd19ebab0a46930d6.gif[/img]

We're bringing you a brand new chapter set in the industrial wasteland, with a new plant and tons of new industrial building materials to use in the Sandbox. Turn rusting factories into overgrown forests. 

[b]Industrial Chapter Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]🏭 Industrial Chapter with 14 New Levels
[*]📦 50+ New Industrial Items
[*]🌲 New Plant: Pine Tree
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/b259f8451368bb4bcbd70a898fbdd3866b1e2b8c.gif[/img]

We're also extremely excited to bring you Gamepad Support! Now play Cloud Gardens from the comfort of your couch with a controller in mind. Designed from the ground up, and not just porting over mouse and keyboard controls, using a gamepad is truly a relaxing and elegant way to tend to your gardens.*

[b]Gamepad Support:[/b]
[list]
[*]🎮 Gamepad Support
[*]🎛️ Complete UI Overhaul
[*]🧤 Gardening Glove Cursor
[/list]
[i]We're still working on showing the correct "input hints" throughout the game, so if you see a mouse instead of a thumbstick don't be alarmed. Expect this to be patched very soon. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/560c28834ffecfe2e200e32475fd80e2d413171d.gif[/img]

With this update we're also introducing a tooon of new Quality of Life improvements. Alongside a complete UI overhaul to provide better clarity and work smoothly with the new gamepad controls, we've also added improved keyboard controls and shortcuts. And last, but certainly now least, the Auto-Item Grabber, the next item in the queue will now be automatically given to you. While this seems small, I can assure you the developer writing these patch notes is Over The Moon about this change. It makes the game [i]so much smoother[/i], one of those "how did we ever live without it?" changes.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]🎛️ Complete UI Overhaul
[*]📹 Free-cam in Photo Mode 
[*]👓 UI can be turned off in Photo Mode
[*]⌨️ Improved Keyboard Controls
[*]🤏 Auto Item Grabber
[*]🌧️ Rain Card
[*]🔉 New Audio Effects
[*]🐌 Gnome Audio Effects
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/4ac59fbfdc2c2d3ee373abed9bf502574aef1fe2.gif[/img]

[b]Other Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]When doing a recording with a lot of growing plants, they are now timed to all grow within the length of the recording
[*]Player can now drag to move the camera while holding an item
[*]Rain bubbles no longer disappear when saving & loading a game
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/9db44e16b720fe8e77471415e01862889608032d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update #3: Railroads Chapter, Sandbox Tools, and More!
notes.content:
Welcome to the last update of 2020: Featuring the largest chapter we've made yet, and numerous highly requested features and big improvements to the Sandbox!

New scenes, new plants, new props, new features, and more! 

[h2]Railroads Chapter[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/b8c416b3ebb057b69f92b7751ea13463806e9a57.png[/img]

Grow your way across [b]our 18 new scenes[/b], from small countryside train stops to abandoned industrial freight stations, and everything in between. 

[b]Chapter Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]🛤️ Railroads Chapter with 18 New Scenes
[*]🚃 85+ New Props
[*]🌿 New Plant: Ferns
[*]🌳 New Plant: Willow Tree
[*]🌴 New Plant: Palm Tree
[*]🌇 New Sandbox Skyboxes
[/list]

[h2]New Features & Sandbox Improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/7da05c5a679b644a52ca961b12ccc6e58f488cd1.gif[/img]

This update brings a bunch of new features which have paved the way for various Sandbox improvements. We're very excited to bring the hotly requested feature that is [b]Grid Snapping[/b]! That's right! You're living on a grid now. Misaligned blocks are a thing of the past! Grid Snapping is enabled in both Campaign and Sandbox mode, allowing players to precisely align their blocks before placement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/1e2b1ce7338b2fd1dac4eee901e17ffbd513fa75.gif[/img]

We've also added a host of new tools: [b]a "gizmo" for moving objects[/b] in the sandbox after you've placed them, [b]a saw to cut plants[/b] into the exact shape you want, and a [b]vacuum[/b] to collect loads of fruit immediately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/91352365a9cdb75afe9bb2b082e53b4baad014e9.gif[/img]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]🌐 Grid Snapping
[*]🗺️ Customisable Bases
[*]⚒️ Gizmo for moving props
[*]🪓 Chainsaw for pruning plants
[*]🕳️ Vacuum for collecting fruits
[*]📦 Updated Prop Select UI
[*]🎊 'Surprise Me' Button
[/list]

[h2]Additional Changes and Bug Fixes[/h2]

In addition to the main new features, we've made a ton of smaller quality of life changes, as well as squashed a whole host of bugs. We want to give extra special thanks to our community of testers* on Discord who really showed up for this update and gave us a ton of feedback on early builds. Their testing helped us make the update the best it could be, and we're very grateful for them. 

If you'd like to join our Discord, and have the chance to play early content then please join us here: 

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added: Undo Button in Chapter Mode that lets players return the last prop they used. 
[*] Added: Circular Greenhouse Base in the Sandbox. 
[*] Added: Scene Select shows which scenes have been completed vs. skipped. 
[*] Tweak: 'Batch Blips' now fill the whole circle around the clump at the start of a scene, and deplete from there.
[*] Tweaked: Scenes can unlock up to 10 props, up from 5. 
[*] Tweak: Automatically selects the first used seed as the seed type in the incubator.
[*] Tweak: Improved Seed Cards overview.
[*] Tweak: Greatly reduced file size of recorded videos. 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Scene Selects shows the incorrect number when opening the window.
[*] Fixed: Props refuse to place sometimes.
[*] Fixed: Scrolling inside UI will also zoom the game.
[*] Fixed: When skipping between scenes, sometimes the skybox glitches out during transition.
[*] Fixed: Energy and Props are not carried over to next stage of some scenes.
[*] Fixed: Saved games on 'Staged Scenes' broken.
[*] Fixed: Outlines do not highlight the entire object, on some props.
[/list]

[i]*Many thanks to Avyctes, Baptiste, Finn Huckleberry, InkBleederWolf, Jimothy, Kylafi, Loadings, Mk-0, Murray Hailstorm, ⊨TakingFire⇒, and themintymonster for being on the front lines of bug hunting on this one![/i]

notes.title: Update #3: Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/5be6a6e7bdba828c1944d0cb9dd7404a05352f17.png[/img]
[i]Cover Images by Eric Leonard Jr.[/i]

As 2020 comes to a close we have exciting details to share about our last big update for the year. Coming before the end of the year, Update #3 combines long requested sandbox features with a full new chapter themed around trains!

[h1]Train Chapter[/h1]

[h3]🚉 Trains Chapter 🚉[/h3]
A brand new chapter featuring everybody's* favorite means of transportation: trains! That's right train heads, get excited. Design a suite of train platforms. Are you a cozy platform person with a few vending machines for the commuters, or do you prefer industrial freight cars in it for the long haul? The train chapter will cater to all sorts of decaying-train-station desires!

*Disclaimer: Anecdotal survey recorded among devs. Trains may not in fact be [i]everybody's[/i] favorite means of transportation.

[h3]🌱 New Plants 🌱[/h3]
With new chapters come new plants, with new plants come new garden possibilities! The train chapter will feature the more new plants than any update yet, and that's all I can say for now. 

[h3]🔓 Unlocks 🔓[/h3]
New props to unlock throughout the chapter to build your own train stations in the Sandbox!  

[h1]The Sandbox[/h1]

[h3]🌐 Grid Snapping 🌐[/h3]
That's right, you asked for it and we're bringing it! Probably one of our most requested features, grid snapping is finally coming to Cloud Gardens. Architectural props, and props that connect together will now be placed on a grid.

[h3]🏔️ Customizable Sandbox Bases 🏔️[/h3]
Small, medium, large? These are concepts of the past! From now on YOU get to decide the size of our creations. Small-Medium? You can build it. Large-ish? Go for it. Weird L-Shape? Yeah, if that's what you want. Bases in the sandbox are now made out of modular components which you'll be able to piece together to create the base of your dreams. 

[h3]🧰 Sandbox Tools 🧰[/h3]
The sandbox will be getting a suite of new tools which will help gardeners take extra care of their builds. Need to prune back some of your plants to make the perfect vine? Use the Prune Tool! Need a little inspiration? Use the Random Prop Button to get some. 

[h3]✨ Visual & Organizational Menu Updates ✨[/h3]
The prop finder is getting a visual and organizational overhaul. Now with clear categories it should be easier than ever to find what you were looking for. 

[h3]🌿 Even More! 🌿[/h3]
Along with the usual suite of bug fixes and tweaks, there are still a few features in the hopper which we'll talk more about closer to launch. 

[h2]More to come in early 2021![/h2]

We'll have more to talk about in 2021 with a new chapter, more plants, props, sandbox upgrades, and some exciting features we can't wait to share. If you can't wait til then feel free to drop by our community Discord, where we listen to feedback, share gardens, talk about development, and occasionally let slip update details before they make it into Steam posts ;) 

Until next time,

Eli & Thomas

notes.title: Halloween Sale Discount!
notes.content:
It's spooOOooky scary sales season!! In honor of ghouls, ghosts, and gardeners everywhere Cloud Gardens will be on sale from October 29th to November 2nd. 

If you haven't already now is the perfect time to jump into Cloud Gardens! With the release of the Greenhouse Update and the Pumpkin Patch (Halloween Update) we've nearly doubled the amount of levels in the game, adding 2 whole new Chapters with almost 25 new levels among them, now for a total of 5 Chapters up from 3.

notes.title: The Pumpkin Patch: Halloween Chapter
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38348491/97a01d3abe2d11fc5a9f3909c2322fb0820eeabe.png[/img]

Tis' the season of not just Ghouls and Goblins, but Gardeners too! Welcome to the Pumpkin Patch, our spooOOoooky Halloween Update chock full of new content with a brand new Halloween themed chapter complete with new level, props, sandbox skyboxes and perhaps a literal pumpkin patch. 

That's not all, we wanted something to make the Halloween levels feel extra special, so I'd like to introduce you to the brand new Cobweb item! Is it a plant? No! It is kind of like a plant? Yes! Though Cobwebs don't produce fruits or give seeds, you can still grow them out and use them to cover your levels. They're a seasonal experiment in expanding our plant growing system to non-plant objects, and we're excited to see how you like it :)

This update is also very special because it features not but two levels inspired directly by a user from the Cloud Gardens Discord community. Without getting into too many details here, the 6th and 7th Halloween levels were inspired by Discord user [i]Smile[/i] who originally suggested these prehistoric levels. 

Now to get down to the nitty gritty spooky details: 

[b][h3]The Pumpkin Patch Notes:  [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] 🎃 Halloween Chapter w/ 9 New Levels
[*] 🕸️ New Cobweb "Seed"*
[*] 👻 Spooky & Silly Pumpkins
[*] 🧙‍♀️ Gnome-Witches!!**
[*] 🏚️ Community Inspired Levels
[*] 🔮 25 New Spooky Props, all Unlockable in the Sandbox
[*] 🌃 2 New Halloween Themed Sandbox Skyboxes
[*] 🎃🎃🎃 A literal Pumpkin Patch***
[/list]

[i]Notes:
* Disclaimer: Cobwebs are not seeds, they will not produce fruits. 
** Not to be confused with Sand-Witches, who usually only appear during the summer. 
***Disclaimer: As literal as any digital Pumpkin Patch can be.[/i]

notes.title: Double Update: The Greenhouse & The Pumpkin Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38348491/c4a12f61687ac1e875b2aef87f3c08d53c02c0bc.png[/img]

Welcome Gardeners to our first major update, and wow this one is a doozey! We have not one, but two brand new chapters! Bring new life to the rusting ruins of a once great [i][b]Greenhouse[/b][/i] or get down and spooky with some Gnome-Witches in the [i][b]Pumpkin Patch[/b][/i] levels. 

With almost 25 new levels we've nearly doubled the length of the game, as well as adding new seeds, props, sandbox skyboxes, and more! 

[h2]The Greenhouse[/h2]

Teased at the end of levels included at launch, you'll now have access to the full Greenhouse Chapter, complete with 15 levels, brand new plants, and lots of new props. Grow bamboo, mushroom, and reed gardens among the crumbling ruins of rusted greenhouses. 

Create your own greenhouses in the sandbox with over 25 New Greenhouse props to unlock! Or explore what other folks have made on the Official Cloud Gardens Discord server. 

[h3][b]Greenhouse Chapter[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 🌸 New Chapter w/ 15 New Levels
[*] 🏛 Largest and most ambitious level yet
[*] 🍄 New Plant: Mushroom
[*] 🌾 New Plant: Reeds
[*] 🎍 Bamboo
[*] 📦 25+ New Unlockable Props for Sandbox
[*] 🌅 New Sandbox Skyboxes
[/list]

[h2]The Pumpkin Patch[/h2]

Ghosts, ghouls, and gardeners, all are welcome in the Pumpkin Patch! What started out as a small joke to add a pumpkin to the Greenhouse Update once we realized it was realized around Halloween took on a life of it's own. The Pumpkin Patch is a whole new Halloween themed chapter complete with a new "seed"-like-thing, unlockable props, and more!  

[b][h3]The Pumpkin Patch Notes:  [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] 🎃 Halloween Chapter w/ 9 New Levels
[*] 🕸️ New Cobweb "Seed"*
[*] 👻 Spooky & Silly Pumpkins
[*] 🧙‍♀️ Gnome-Witches!!**
[*] 🏚️ Community Inspired Levels
[*] 🔮 25 New Spooky Props, all Unlockable in the Sandbox

[h2]Odds and Ends[/h2]

There's also the usual inclusion of various bug fixes. Special thanks to our playtesters on Discord for helping find a lot of these.  

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

notes.title: Greenhouse Update: Coming October 29th
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the Greenhouse Update will be coming out [b]next week on October 29th[/b]!!!

As the first of many major updates to come this marks an exciting milestone for us to be able to share all sorts of new goodies with our Early Access players. The Greenhouse update is chock full of new content for new and returning gardeners alike. 

[h1][b]Greenhouse Chapter[/b][/h1]
Bring new life to the remains of an abandoned Greenhouse as you overgrow forgotten and crumbling structures. [b]Explore 15+ new levels[/b] which feature of the most ambitious levels and designs included in the game so far. 

[h1][b]New Plants[/b][/h1]
Discover [b]two new varieties of plants[/b] in the ruins of the Greenhouse to add to your gardens. These plants are unlocked by playing the chapter and can be used in the Sandbox or in old levels once unlocked. 

[h3][b][i]1. Fungus Among Us[/i][/b][/h3]
Mushroom heads rejoice as Cloud Gardens gets its first fungi! The unique zig-zagging growing pattern of the mushroom is sure to be a nice addition to any garden.

[h3][b][i]2. Hiding in the Tall Grass[/i][/b][/h3]
While I don't want to spoil everything in this announcement, I will say that I'm very excited for everyone to get their hands on this second plant. There isn't anything that quite fills its role in the game currently. 

[h1][b]New Sandbox Props[/b][/h1]
As you complete each Greenhouse level unlock new props from those levels to be used in the Sandbox Mode. [b]With over 35+ new props[/b] we're excited to see the Greenhouses that the community makes in the days and weeks to come after launch. 

[h1][b]A Chill in the Wind. . . [/b][/h1]
Well that's almost all for today, but I can't leave without sowing a few seeds of mystery. In light of the fall season we decided to add something extra special to our first major update. If you thought everything above sounded cool, then keep your eyes peels for something extra. . . spoOOoooky, coming soon! 

Until next time!

Eli & Thomas

notes.title: Apocalyptic planting game Cloud Gardens enters early access today
notes.content:
There’s something slightly spooky but alluring about the remains of urban civilisation rusting away in the apocalypse covered with ivy and grasses and bright flowers. Cloud Gardens puts you in nature’s boots, directing the growth of all these lovely plant life forms in little dioramas that serve as your canvas. I could almost get caught up just looking at screenshots, but if you’re in the mood to give it a go, it launches in early access today.

notes.title: Cloud Gardens will cultivate ruined urban ecosystems later this year
notes.content:
If there’s one thing we can all seem to agree on, it’s that human civilisation will make a beautiful corpse – A quiet reassurance to the idea that, even once we’ve all bitten the dust, life will find a way to carry on regardless of the concrete messes we leave behind. Announced today, Cloud Gardens wants you to tend to those spaces, helping life flourish from urban decay when it arrives on Steam next year.
